The discussion focused on analyzing traffic differences using a specific dashboard link. [p1] presented data comparing historical traffic (August through lockdown) and noted predicted decreases: approximately 20% reduction from August, and about 37% reduction for the period between October and lockdown.

[p1] also stated that during the lockdown period, actual traffic was below the real traffic in two instances. Finally, [p1] confirmed leaving the current model for Malls.
decisions: The analysis covered traffic differences from August through the lockdown period.
